_doc: Compiled from tools/items/shops.tsv, stock.tsv, jobs.tsv and services.tsv. Do not edit.

jobs.task: Carry bowls to the counter in order and clear them; the evening rush doubles the orders
Stock the shelves to the list and run two deliveries to the residential streets
Water the buckets, then deliver bouquets; each bouquet's flowers must match what it says
Serve tea to the right cushions; refill and bow
Sell, stock and bargain at the family counter
Carry deliveries across the village; place them where the customer points
Pump the bellows to the colour the smith calls, quench on time, sweep
Fold towels, stoke the boiler to the right heat, keep the floor dry
Carry and stack timber; plane boards to the master's line
Sort herbs from the drying racks, grind for the herbalist

services.effect: Refreshed: fatigue cleared to the start of Tired and Well Rested for two hours
Restores a weapon's durability
services.note: ceil(base price x missing durability x 0.3); masterwork x1.5

services.effect: A quarter of a blade's durability while you wait
A fine-grade weapon in three days
services.note: 2.2 x base price; half as a deposit

services.effect: Change a folded outfit's palette to another of its own
Recolour one role of an outfit to any wardrobe colour
An outfit of the collections in your clan's palette (clan members) or your own colours
services.note: 1.5 x the outfit's price; three days

services.effect: Any furniture piece in a chosen wood or colour
A fine-grade piece from the yard's blueprints
Ramen for the squad delivered to a training ground or your flat
services.note: Feeds four; counts as a squad meal (bond experience)

services.effect: A table held for the squad's evening
services.note: Required for the squad dinner after Ch 14; refunded against the bill

services.effect: Order a technique scroll of your natures not in this week's stock
A bouquet delivered to a resident's door with your note
services.note: Counts as a gift; one a day

services.effect: A painted portrait of you, or of you with a friend (a hanging scroll)
A kenjutsu lesson at the Gekko dojo: training XP and blade proficiency
A footwork lesson: training XP and a shorter dodge cooldown for the day
An offering: a day of the shrine's small luck
Adopt a ninken pup
services.note: Includes a collar and a day of kibble

services.effect: Adopt a cat
Buy a small house
services.note: The home session's number (no rent: homes are bought or given)

services.effect: The mover packs your furniture and chests into moving crates
services.note: Per move; the home session's number

services.effect: Found a clan
Open one hall of your estate
A personal trip to an open far region
A new hairstyle from those you have unlocked
A new hair colour
Add, change or remove face marks
